news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.description: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.

news.title: Comex Gold, Silver Settle Lower
news.description: Gold settled 1.4% lower, down two of the past three sessions, and silver fell 2.5%, down three of the past four sessions.

news.title: DeepSeek Won't Sink U.S. AI Titans
news.description: Panic fueling the selloff of Nvidia, Broadcom and other tech giants is overblown.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.description: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Arabica Coffee Prices Hit Record on U.S., Colombia Tariff Spat
news.description: Arabica coffee prices hit a record level, as traders digested the withdrawal of President Trump’s threats to impose tariffs and economic sanctions on Colombia.

news.title: This sanctioned Russian stablecoin claims it processes billions, but blockchain analysts disagree
news.description: A7A5 claims crypto data providers understate its trading activity, while blockchain analytics firms say the ruble-backed token's volumes have fallen sharply this year.

news.title: Trump says there is ‘nothing wrong’ with family’s crypto windfall
news.description: The president reported at least $1.4 billion in crypto income for 2025. He told CNBC he did nothing illegal and was not aware of the extent of his holdings. Critics say he is profiting from the office while his administration writes the industry's rules.

news.title: Bitcoin whales bought $16.7 billion of bitcoin in 2 weeks even as ETFs bled a record $4 billion
news.description: U.S. institutional demand had its worst month ever in June. Large holders absorbed the selling, marking a divergence that has shown up near past cycle bottoms.
